The 2025 Range Rover SE represents the flagship lineup, blending legendary off-road heritage with minimalist, modern aesthetics. It remains a luxury SUV benchmark, offering a refined driving experience defined by effortless power and a serene cabin environment.

Performance
The SE trim offers two primary powertrains. The standard P400 features a 3.0-liter turbocharged inline-six engine with a mild-hybrid system, producing horsepower and lb-ft of torque. For more authority, the P530 brings a 4.4-liter twin-turbo V8 delivering horsepower and lb-ft of torque. Both utilize an eight-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. Driving dynamics are enhanced by electronic air suspension with adaptive dynamics.

Design
The exterior follows a reductive design philosophy, featuring flush-deployable door handles and seamless waistlines. The SE sits on standard-inch wheels. Inside, the cabin uses premium materials like Windsor leather and fine wood veneers. The layout is clean and uncluttered, emphasizing horizontal lines and open space.
Technology
The dashboard centers on a 13.1-inch Pivi Pro curved glass touchscreen handling vehicle functions. It supports wireless smartphone integration and over-the-air updates. Drivers use a 13.7-inch interactive display for navigation or media. A Meridian Sound System is standard, providing an immersive audio experience.
Advanced Safety Features
The Range Rover SE includes a comprehensive suite of assistance technologies. Standard features include emergency braking, blind spot assist, and a 3D surround camera system. Adaptive cruise control with steering assist helps maintain lane position, while traffic sign recognition and driver condition monitoring enhance safety during travel.
Convenience and Comfort
The interior features 20-way heated and ventilated front seats and power-recline heated rear seats. Three-zone climate control allows individualized settings, while the air purification system ensures quality. Convenience features include a powered gesture tailgate, soft-close doors, and a sliding panoramic roof. Wireless charging and multiple ports keep passengers connected.

That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control with lane change - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control with lane change, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles.   • GPS linked cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control with lane change - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control with lane change, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up, and helps you make lane changes. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, hands-on cruise control with lane change.

  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

In essence, the 2026 BMW iX xDrive60 Sports Activity Vehicle offers an impressive combination of luxury, innovation, and sustainability, making it a stellar choice for those seeking a high-performance electric SUV.

The Super Cruise hands-free driver assistance system allows you to enjoy a more relaxed and confident journey, while the Rear Camera Mirror, Reverse Automatic Braking, and Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert provide added peace of mind when navigating busy roads or towing.

Whether you're embarking on a family adventure, hauling heavy loads, or simply seeking the ultimate in luxury and performance, the 2023 Cadillac Escalade Sport Platinum is the perfect companion. Experience the pinnacle of automotive excellence and visit our showroom today to explore this exceptional SUV in person.

This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
